profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Box
profile.summary:
Software engineer with extensive experience in large-scale software infrastructure. I have safely developed numerous critical backend features to high volume and critical services. 

I enjoy working with talented and diverse team of engineers and strive to develop efficient and scalable software solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer ll
positions.description: Building, maintaining, upgrading containerized RESTful Java microservices with Spring Boot framework, Jersey, Tomcat, Kubernetes, Swagger, and other tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of student engineers, product managers, and designers to build RoomU, an app that allows students to find roommates
- Implemented a profile page and filters with the Figma design given by designers

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
- Migrated a service from monolith into a standalone microservice
- Implemented unit, integration, and component test
- Implemented a layered architecture for the microservice

positions.title: Math Tutor
positions.description: Provided academic assistance to students from a variety of math and computer science courses.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted a math professor with office works and occasionally tutored students when needed.
